title: Dontay Corleone 2026 NFL Draft Profile - NewsBreak
text:
By Trey Daubert ,
6 hours ago Dontay Corleone is next for the 2026 NFL Draft profile series. Check out the report on the Cincinnati DT inside the post! (Gemini) Dontay Corleone 2026 NFL Draft Profile Excited to talk about this one. Love me some Dontay Corleone. Let’s have a chat and get through this next 2026 NFL Draft profile!
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2024 Week 4 , 2026 Week 1 , East-West Shrine Bowl Day One , Day Two , Player Interview
@treydaubert Dontay Corleone ranks the Godfather movies #dontaycorleone #nfldraft #eastwestbowl
♬ original sound – Trey Daubert Corleone, 23, was a three star recruit during the 2021 cycle. The Cincinnati native signed with the Bearcats staying close to home. He never left the program for the portal. Hailing from Colerain high school, he was also listed as the 149th ranked DL and 48th player in the state of Ohio.
Checking in at 6-foot, 340, Corleone was an impact guy right away as a freshman. He posted three sacks and two forced fumbles that year. I remember watching an Oklahoma game that following year in another three sack season, and he’s been on my radar ever since. When you made as much noise as he did against Oklahoma, it was time to start paying attention (stock note link at the top).
Corleone was building momentum to be a high pick. Just that sort of tank DT who wins with power and leverage. Bowling ball of hell vibes that wrecks games. Corleone posted 3.5 sacks the following year, but then we got hit with the bad news.
The medical stuff is going to play a factor here. Wish it wasn’t, but that’s the reality we live in. Corleone got hit with blood clots. Wasn’t the same guy. Also, had a walking boot on at the East-West game in person. Didn’t workout at the Combine for that reason. I don’t have access to the medical reports, obviously. When I do, I won’t be typing these anymore, so you’re welcome. Regardless, that’s something to keep in mind, but by all accounts, he should be good to go as we project forward.
The accolades speak for themselves. First-team All-American Athletic Conference as a freshman. Second-team All-Big 12 Conference the following year. First-team All-Big 12 in 2024 and team captain while dealing with blood clots. Second-team All-Big 12 this past year, even though it was a down year.
In terms of the Combine , as I said, there’s no workout to review. Did have some good moments during practice at the Shrine Bowl. Awesome interview too. But I saw the rest of what I needed to see in person. First step is not fast. He wins with leverage and power. He needs someone next to him who can win with speed. Does well against the run. Not the sexiest pass rusher, but he can do it. He’s just a bull rush guy though.
Rayshaun Benny 2026 NFL Draft Profile Big fan of this player. Sounds like you can have him at a discount too. Definitely one of my favorite middle round targets who I think will develop into a real starter.
